Title: Forward Deployed Engineer
Description:
We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving team operating in a startup-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer: someone who works close to business teams, understands messy operational problems, and turns AI, data, and automation into practical solutions.

You will work across domains such as energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors — not as an external consultant, but as part of the group itself, with the ownership and continuity of an internal product and engineering team.

You will identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools, evaluate impact, and help deploy solutions that remove bottlenecks, improve decision-making, and create leverage across the business.




About the Team

We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.

We care about building things that work in the real world: useful tools, reliable automations, better workflows, and systems that create measurable impact.

We appreciate people who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem solving, and working directly with users to understand how things actually get done.




What You’ll Do

Design and build AI-enabled solutions that make the organization faster and smarter:

AI applications, agents, and automation workflows for real business processes
Data analysis, decision-support tools, and internal analytics workflows
Retrieval, document intelligence, structured outputs, and knowledge systems
Prototypes that test whether AI can create real operational value
Integrations with internal tools, databases, APIs, documents, and third-party systems
Evaluation and monitoring approaches to understand whether AI systems are working as intended




You’ll work directly with business and technical teams to understand problems, identify opportunities, prototype solutions, measure impact, and iterate — not just execute predefined specs.




What We Offer

A high-autonomy role with direct influence on how AI is applied across the group
Real business problems with visible impact
Modern AI-assisted tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches
A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people
A broad variety of technical and business challenges across different domains
Competitive compensation and benefits
Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup.




You’re Probably a Fit If

You have hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, data science, or analytics to real business problems.
You enjoy working close to users and business teams, understanding how work actually happens, and turning messy problems into useful AI-enabled solutions.
You are comfortable working with LLMs, modern AI APIs, structured and unstructured data, and know how to evaluate whether an AI solution is actually useful.
You can explore a dataset, identify patterns or opportunities, prototype a solution, and communicate trade-offs clearly.
You are pragmatic about AI: excited by what it can do, but aware of its limitations, failure modes, and the importance of good evaluation.
You have enough software engineering ability to build reliable prototypes, integrations, automations, or internal tools, preferably using Python.




Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, agent frameworks, workflow automation, forecasting, optimization, BI tools, Postgres, AWS, or complex operational domains is a strong plus.

You do not need experience with every technology we use. Curiosity, analytical thinking, adaptability, and the ability to turn AI into practical business impact matter much more.

If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
At Lexroom.ai, we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.

In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.

We’re growing fast, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team committed to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the evolution of legal AI with the same rigor and precision that define our product.

Why Lexroom.ai?


Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional minds driven by competence, curiosity, and ambition.
Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will empower legal professionals to make faster, clearer, and more reliable decisions worldwide.


At Lexroom.ai, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

What You'll Do


Design and build agent-driven and RAG-based AI systems to solve complex legal tasks with precision and efficiency.
Fine-tune and post-train LLMs using cutting-edge supervised and reinforcement learning techniques to raise response quality.
Develop and optimize large-scale search pipelines for LLM-powered agents.
Implement and refine NLP algorithms to extract, structure, and validate information from legal documents.
Run end-to-end evaluations to pinpoint bottlenecks, measure performance, and guide continuous improvements.
Work closely with legal experts to design evaluation protocols and build reliable, domain-specific datasets that strengthen every layer of the stack.
Maintain technical excellence by following established best practices, coding standards, and rigorous code-review processes.


What You’ll Bring


Proven expertise in building and managing robust ML pipelines.
Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in LLM research and deep learning systems.
Knowledge of search technologies such as full-text search, vector databases, or other large-scale retrieval systems.
Collaborative mindset and readiness to work with legal experts, researchers, and engineers to keep improving the product.
Familiarity with MLOps and integrating ML models into production backends (a strong plus).
Up-to-date with LLM innovation, ideally with experience in pre-training or deploying large-scale models in real-world scenarios.


What Sets Us Apart

An Exceptional Team.

At Lexroom.ai, you’ll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI.

Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results.

You’ll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth.

Growth that Matters.

We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead.

As we scale, your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field.

Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you’re ready to take responsibility, you’ll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects.

Rewarding Your Contribution.

We value excellence and share success:


Annual Salary Range: €45,000 – €100,000
Equity Package: Align your growth with the company’s long-term success.


Benefits That Matter


Hybrid Work: Flexibility to balance remote work with in-person collaboration at our Milan HQ.
Health Coverage: Comprehensive insurance to keep you secure and focused.
Meal Vouchers: Daily support for your lunch breaks.
Performance Bonuses: Rewards directly tied to measurable results.
Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas.
At Lexroom.ai, ambition meets discipline and purpose.


We’re not just building a product—we’re setting a new standard for the legal world. If you’re ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we’d love to hear from you.**

Compensation Range: €40K - €100K

Title: Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI team focused on bringing ML & Generative AI into the heart of our operations (e.g. claims, underwriting, customer support).

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to redefine the core operative processes, leveraging ML & GenAI techniques to enhance not only efficiency but, most importantly, the overall effectiveness and quality of outcomes.

You’ll collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business leaders to design and deliver AI-driven products that create tangible business value and redefine the future of ops at Prima.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Leverage Machine Learning and GenAI to solve complex business problems, making our processes better and faster;
Analyze and interpret complex data to support decision-making;
Contribute directly to Prima’s long-term success and financial impact through concrete solutions.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in quantitative fields such as Math, Physics, Data Science, or Engineering;
All experience levels, including recent graduates with no prior working experience;
Strong analytical and quantitative skills;
Structured problem solving skills and being able to analyze and break down complex problems;
Curiosity, proactivity, quick learning and an innovative mindset.


Nice-to-Have


Hands-on experience with Python and coding best practices;
Experience with machine learning and Generative AI (openAI/Gemini APIs, agentic frameworks, …)
Business proficiency in Italian or Spanish, in addition to English.


€38,000 - €55,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks..

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Votre mission

En tant que Data Scientist, vous rejoignez notre équipe R&D et avez pour mission de développer des solutions d’IA pour optimiser nos outils métiers de conception et de dimensionnement des ouvrages. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

  • Développement de modèles d’IA pour améliorer la précision et l’efficacité des processus de conception et de dimensionnement ;
  • Préparation et nettoyage des données pour les rendre exploitables par les algorithmes d’IA ;
  • Intégration des modèles d’IA dans nos outils métiers existants, potentiellement via des projets de recherche innovants ;
  • Collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie et d’architecture pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées ;
  • Veille technologique pour identifier les nouvelles tendances et innovations en matière d’IA et de data science.

Votre profil

  • Vous disposez d’un master ou d’un doctorat en data science, intelligence artificielle, ingénierie, mathématiques appliquées, ou domaine connexe ;
  • Vous avez quelques années d’expérience en data science et intelligence artificielle, dans le développement de modèles de machine learning et de deep learning, ainsi que dans l’intégration de modèles d’IA dans des applications métiers ;
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de traitement de données (Python, R, SQL, etc.) et les méthodes de préparation et de nettoyage des données ;
  • Vous avez des compétences de communication et de pédagogie nécessaires au partage de votre savoir ;
  • Vous êtes animé(e) par la recherche de solutions techniques innovantes et parfaitement adaptées ;
  • Vous êtes sensible aux domaines de l’architecture et de la construction ;
  • Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif et vous impliquer dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire ;
  • La connaissance du néerlandais et/ou de l’anglais est un plus.


Nous vous proposons de

  • Travailler sur une grande variété de projets ;
  • Faire évoluer vos responsabilités et élargir votre champ de compétences ;
  • Rejoindre une équipe dans laquelle l’ambiance de travail a toute son importance, et où l’humain est au cœur des réflexions et le bien-être au cœur des décisions ;
  • Intégrer un bureau d’études qui agit concrètement en faveur du développement durable et l’opportunité de participer à ses objectifs de responsabilité sociétale ;
  • Disposer d’un package salarial en ligne avec votre expérience et des avantages extra-légaux : assurance hospitalisation, assurance décès, assurance pension, budget mobilité, congés d’ancienneté, plan cafétéria.


Votre lieu de travail

  • Liège (Angleur), dans le cadre verdoyant du Liège Science Park

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As a Data Scientist, you'll join a forward-thinking Sports Analytics company leveraging data and AI to redefine how teams analyse performance, and develop strategies. You'll build advanced predictive models and analytics solutions that turn complex sports data into actionable insights, enabling smarter decisions across performance, scouting, and business operations.




Responsibilities

Develop and deploy machine learning models for player performance analysis, injury prediction, match outcome forecasting, fan engagement, and customer analytics.
Analyse large, complex datasets including player tracking, wearable sensor, event, video-derived, and historical performance data to generate actionable insights.
Design predictive models and statistical analyses to optimise player recruitment, tactical decision-making, and performance monitoring.
Build interactive dashboards and visualisations to communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Evaluate model performance and continuously improve algorithms through experimentation and feature engineering.




Your Profile

2–5 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Statistics, or a related field.
Strong Python and SQL skills.
Hands-on experience developing predictive models using libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience working with large structured and unstructured datasets and performing statistical analysis.
Knowledge of feature engineering, experimentation, forecasting, clustering, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is an advantage.
Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Plotly is beneficial.
Experience within Sports Analytics, HealthTech, wearable technology, performance analytics, or fan engagement platforms is considered a strong plus.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to both technical and business stakeholders.




The Offer

Hybrid working with offices based in Mechelen.
Opportunity to build innovative data science solutions within the rapidly growing Sports Analytics industry.
Work with cutting-edge datasets including player tracking, wearable sensor, performance, and fan engagement data.
Strong investment in technical development, conferences, certifications, and career progression.
Competitive salary package of up to €6,000, depending on experience.
Company car or mobility budget.
Meal vouchers, group and hospitalisation insurance, and additional holiday allowance.
Clear progression opportunities into Senior Data Scientist, Lead Data Scientist, AI Specialist, or Head of Data.
Collaborative and innovation-driven team working at the intersection of sport, data, and artificial intelligence.




If this opportunity excites you, apply today or send your CV and a short cover letter to ryan.martin@vividresourcing.com.

Les statistiques

De la connaissance des méthodologies agiles

Title: Data Scientist Engineer
Description:
Devoteam is a leading consulting firm focused on digital transformation. We help our clients leverage technology to achieve their business goals.

Our longstanding partnerships with leaders like AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and ServiceNow amplify our capabilities, allowing us to deliver top-tier expertise and award-winning services. We complement these partnerships with in-depth Cyber, Data & AI, Software development and multi cloud expertise.

For 30 years, we have always been guiding our customers on the next tech wave. Devoteam has guided organizations through the Internet and cloud. The next revolution? AI.

With 11,000 tech natives working in 25+ countries, we bring you highly skilled IT experts across Europe

At Devoteam, tech is in our DNA, and it’s the people we empower with tech. Now, with responsible AI, we’re ready to unlock a future where technology drives positive change.

Job Description

Are you passionate about data-driven platforms, machine learning models, and innovative applications? As a Data Scientist/Engineer at Devoteam, you'll play a hands-on role in delivering impactful solutions across various clients and industries. Each mission we undertake has clear deliverables and deadlines, ensuring you gain diverse experience. For example, one month you might develop a predictive maintenance model, and the next, a customer segmentation model for a retail client.

Key Responsibilities:


Platform Setup: Design and implement robust data platforms using Azure, AWS or Google Cloud and Databricks.
Data Management: Gather, prepare, and manage data for analysis.
Model Research: Investigate and select appropriate machine learning models.
ML Modeling: Develop and refine machine learning models.
Client Collaboration: Spend approximately 50% of your time working directly with clients, either independently or as part of a team.



Your Role:


Build and maintain data platforms and pipelines using Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, Databricks, and Python.
Develop predictive and machine learning models tailored to client needs.
Advise clients on translating their business requirements into technical solutions using machine learning techniques.
Stay updated on the latest trends in machine learning and AI, sharing insights with clients.
Act as a strategic partner to client Data Science teams, helping them navigate their challenges and aspirations.
Inspire clients with new data-driven opportunities.
Bring best practices in Git, DevOps, and CICD to enhance client data platforms.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Business Stakeholders.
Represent Devoteam both online and offline, showcasing our expertise.



Qualifications

About You:


Reside in Belgium. (Mandatory)
Hold a university degree in Computer Science, (Business) Engineering, or a specialized master's in Machine Learning or AI.
Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role.
Have a solid understanding of various machine learning models (e.g., SVM, RNN, Deep Learning) and their applications.
Possess foundational knowledge of Data Science, including sampling techniques and evaluation metrics.
Proficient in SQL and Python.
Experience with Spark and/or cloud ecosystems is a must.
Experience with Databricks is real asset
Eager to learn and passionate about data and machine learning technologies.
Excited to join a dynamic and growing team.
Fluent in English; proficiency in Dutch or French is mandatory
Sponsorship for a work permit not possible



Additional Information

Why choose us?


Thrive in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment
Work with innovative and impactful Cloud, Data & AI projects for industry-leading clients
Connect with extraordinary talents in a collaborative and diverse culture
Enjoy a healthy work-life balance in an inspiring, eco-friendly workplace
Competitive compensation package



At Devoteam, we combine strong values – respect, frankness, ambition, entrepreneurship & collaboration – with a fun and supportive environment that empowers you to innovate, grow, and succeed in the fast-paced world of Cloud, Data & AI.

At least 3+ years of experience in Data Science.
Master's degree (or equivalent through experience) in a field that is highly data-driven.
Experience with some of the following data science techniques: supervised and unsupervised learning models, deep learning, anomaly detection, recommender systems, natural language processing, computer vision and reinforcement learning.

Extensive experience in building and implementing advanced analytics solutions backed up with some reference cases.

Insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more
Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development

The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7.

Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow!

Context

The Expertise Center Market Analysis and the Business Platform Power Trading, Structuring & Origination (PTSO) are looking for a Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power to join the Short-Term Power Market Analysis (STP) team in Brussels. The position sits on the trading floor, embedded in an extended team of market analysts, meteorologists, hydrologists and data scientists.

The STP team covers short-term power markets — week-ahead, day-ahead, intraday, ancillary and imbalance — in support of trading and portfolio management activities in Central Western Europe (CWE). Weather has become the dominant driver of these markets: renewable generation, demand and prices are increasingly shaped by it, and extracting value from weather information is one of the team’s key priorities.

This is not a conventional power analyst position. Education & Experience

Languages


Fluent in English.
French and/or Dutch is a plus.

A unique position at the crossroads of weather science and power trading, with direct daily exposure to trading decisions.

Access to best-in-class weather data, proprietary data infrastructure and high-performance computing environments.

Welkom in het team

Als Data Scientist help je mee om complexe data om te zetten in inzichten, modellen en concrete toepassingen die onze business versterken. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende stakeholders en draagt zo actief bij aan innovatie, automatisering en betere beslissingen op basis van data.

Jouw rol in het team:


Je analyseert businessnoden en vertaalt deze naar concrete data science oplossingen en use cases.
Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt modellen en algoritmes (descriptief, predictief en prescriptief).
Je detecteert niet-triviale patronen in data via machine learning en statistische technieken.
Je bouwt en operationaliseert beslissingsalgoritmes en automatisaties samen met de business.
Je beheert de volledige lifecycle van modellen: van intake en ontwikkeling tot monitoring en optimalisatie.
Je werkt met tools zoals Python, R en data science platformen om robuuste oplossingen te bouwen.
Je verzekert de kwaliteit van data en modellen via monitoring, validatie en data cleaning.
Je ondersteunt de business in het begrijpen van inzichten en algoritmes en vertaalt deze naar acties.
Je draagt bij aan een datagedreven cultuur en begeleidt collega’s bij het gebruik van data science oplossingen.
Je werkt samen met stakeholders uit business, IT en data teams om impactvolle oplossingen te realiseren.


Argenta en jij: een match?

Bij alles wat je doet, verlies je nooit onze focuswaarden uit het oog: we werken samen, in alle eenvoud, voor onze klanten.

Je komt terecht in een veilige omgeving waarin je fouten mag maken. En waarin we elkaar durven uitdagen en feedback geven. We zijn ambitieus en leggen de lat hoog. Door elkaar te helpen raken we samen over die lat. Zo maken we een positief verschil voor onze medewerkers, onze klanten en de samenleving.

Wees gerust: bij Argenta kun je gewoon jezelf zijn. Jouw talenten en ambities staan centraal. Groeien en samen winnen, daar gaan we voor.

Een aantrekkelijk brutoloon
Maaltijdcheques
Groepsverzekering
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Netto onkostenvergoeding van 165 euro per maand
Een cafetariaplan waarmee je het bedrag van je 13de maand flexibel kunt inzetten om aan voordelige voorwaarden bijvoorbeeld een smartphone te leasen of extra verlofdagen aan te kopen
Keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen (inclusief tankkaart of laadoplossing) of een aantrekkelijk mobiliteitsbudget dat je kunt spenderen aan duurzame mobiliteitsalternatieven, zoals de aankoop van een fiets, het gebruik van een deelauto of de terugbetaling van je huisvestingskosten

Een goede balans tussen werk en privé vinden we even belangrijk als een mooie verloning. Je werkuren vul je dan ook flexibel in. Op kantoor of thuis werken? Jij kiest. Je werkt gemiddeld 60% van thuis uit.

Je hebt een masterdiploma en relevante ervaring binnen data science.
Je hebt ervaring met data science technieken, algoritmes en machine learning.
Je hebt hands-on ervaring met tools zoals Python, R of gelijkaardig.
Kennis van de LangChain-stack, om de orchestratie van AI-workflows zelfstandig mee vorm te geven, is een plus.
Je bent sterk in het vertalen van businessvragen naar analytische oplossingen.
Je hebt een analytische en kritische mindset en ziet snel verbanden in complexe data.
Je bent communicatief en in staat om complexe inzichten helder uit te leggen aan stakeholders.
Je hebt interesse in AI, IDP, automatisatie en datagedreven procesoptimalisaties.
Je werkt resultaatgericht en proactief en neemt ownership over je oplossingen.
Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring in een financiële context of complexe data-omgevingen.
Je hebt oog voor datakwaliteit, governance en risicobeheersing.

Title: Data Scientist - McKinsey Transformation
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

Working closely with a cross-functional team of data scientists, data engineers, product developers, and analytics-focused consultants, your core responsibility involves collaborating with product management to build performant, robust, and maintainable analytics products that adhere to established data-science approaches and best practices.

You will expand your expertise across various analytics topics, encompassing descriptive analytics as well as the design, development, and refinement of statistical models, optimization techniques, advanced machine learning, and predictive models like boosted trees.

Furthermore, driving the fine-tuning and evaluation of LLMs requires leveraging the latest advancements in neural network architectures and machine learning techniques, optimizing their performance and efficiency particularly for segmentation use cases. Accelerating this development and problem-solving process involves utilizing cutting-edge GenAI tools such as Claude and Cursor, alongside implementing efficient development and maintenance workflows (MLOps) within our Databricks platform.

Translating these complex data analyses into actionable analytical insights directly guides client project directions, while simultaneously fueling your contributions to internal knowledge sharing, research, and technical documentation focused on unstructured data, LLMs, and predictive modeling. Ultimately, all these efforts converge to bring advanced analytics capabilities into one of the firm's flagship products, "Wave" serving as the backbone for how McKinsey runs future transformations and utilizing powerful data science assets to dramatically improve the odds of success for our clients.

You will work in our McKinsey Client Capabilities Network in EMEA and will be part of our Wave Transformatics team.

Wave is a McKinsey SaaS product that equips clients to successfully manage improvement programs and transformations. Focused on business impact, Wave allows clients to track the impact of individual initiatives and understand how they affect longer term goals. It is a mix of an intuitive interface and McKinsey business expertise that gives clients a simple and insightful picture of what can otherwise be a complex process by allowing them to track the progress and performance of initiatives against business goals, budget and time frames.

Our Transformatics team builds data and AI products to provide analytics insights to clients and McKinsey teams involved in transformation programs across the globe. The current team is composed of 3 data engineers, 5 data scientists,1 analyst and 2 PMs who are spread across several geographies. The team covers a variety of industries, functions, analytics methodologies and platforms – e.g. Cloud data engineering, advanced statistics, machine learning, predictive analytics, MLOps and generative AI.

Your Qualifications and Skills


MSc or PhD level in the field of computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics or equivalent by experience
1+ years of experience in data science, statistical modelling (e.g. advanced regressions, clustering, classification models) and machine learning techniques (e.g. random forest, support vector machines, gradient boosting, XGBoost)
Programming experience in the following languages: Python and SQL. Basic understanding of PySpark
Comfortable leveraging the latest GenAI tools (such as Cursor or Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, and problem-solving.
Experience with version control using Git and collaborative development workflows in GitHub (e.g., branching, pull requests, code reviews, and repository management)
Experience collaborating on projects to deploy advanced analytics and data science methods in real-world organizations (CI/CD, deployment observation, etc...)
Familiarity with LLMs agents, RAG systems, prompt engineering, machine learning libraries (scikit-learn) or deep learning libraries (TensorFlow/PyTorch) is a plus
Exposure to tools like Databricks and Tableau is a plus
Effective communication skills, including a readiness to break down analytical concepts, methods, and results for non-technical stakeholders. (e.g. consultants, etc...)

Title: Data Scientist (Space ISR & AI) for NATO with security clearance
Description:
Would you like to join the leading international intergovernmental organization?

This position supports the SHAPE J2 Capability Development (J2 CapDev) in collaboration with the NCIA CTO's Data & AI Center of Excellence (Data & AI CoE). The role is embedded within the AI Opportunities & Solutions Cell to advance space-based Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) workflows and Related Intelligence Capability Programme Plans (CPPs).

Responsibilities:

Geospatial and ISR data science:


Analyse near- and long-term AI opportunities with clear operational value for space-based ISR workflows.
Prepare and curate labelled datasets for assessments, demonstrations, and analysis initiatives.
Recommend methods to strengthen data collection and management to enhance space-based intelligence workflows
Conduct monthly training sessions to educate stakeholders and end users on AI and geospatial data science.
Provide technical/logistical assistance to showcase AI tools and progress during Demo Day or program demonstrations.
Evaluate analytics capabilities and recommend actionable reports for improvement.
Perform a review of emerging AI technologies and recommend applications for NATO's ISR capabilities.
Shared resource: SHAPE J2 Capability Development (J2 CapDev) and NCIA CTO's Data & Ai Center of Excellence (Data & Ai CoE).


Essential Qualifications & Experience:

Data Scientist for AI Opportunities & Solutions Cell for space based Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) and Related Intelligence Capability Programme Plans (CPPs).

Educational Background:


A nationally recognized or certified university degree in data science, mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
Exceptionally, candidates without a university degree may qualify if they possess significant expertise (minimum 3 years) relevant to the role and duties.


Experience:


3+ years working on AI for imagery or geospatial analysis in production or mission environments (industry, government, or defence).
Demonstrated expertise in artificial intelligence/machine learning workflows, including data labelling, preparation, and processing for large-scale imagery or geospatial datasets.
Experience developing and delivering training and demo materials to mixed technical/non-technical audiences.


Technical skills:


Python (NumPy, Pandas) and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Data visualization tools/techniques.


Additional competencies:


Ability to lead ideation sessions, build rapid ML prototypes, and translate operational needs into measurable model/evaluation requirements.
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles.


Language Proficiency:


Fluent in Business English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.


Soft Skills:


Strong problem-solving abilities.
Excellent teamwork, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Experience interacting effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
High motivation with flexibility and adaptability to new challenges.
Creativity

Title: Financial Risk Modeler - Data Scientist
Description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? You’re not alone. Join us in driving progress in the working world and beyond.

Your journey with us

Deloitte Belgium’s Financial Risk department helps organizations identify the risks impacting their business and implement effective and efficient processes to measure and manage these risks (mainly market, credit and liquidity risk). To this end, the team leverages its expertise in data analytics, machine learning techniques and process optimization, combined with a strong understanding of the regulatory and business context.

As a Quantitative Modeler, you will be developing, validating and implementing advanced mathematical and statistical models to address complex financial and business challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong academic background, experience in quantitative methods, and a deep understanding of financial instruments and markets.

What will you be doing?

You Will Join a Team Of Experienced Risk Modelers Where Collaboration And Communication Are At The Heart Of Our Way Of Working. You Are Curious And Analytical, With a Natural Drive To Excel. Amongst Other, Your Activities Will Include


Model Development: Design and develop quantitative models for risk management, utilizing techniques such as Monte Carlo simulation and machine learning.
Model Validation: Conduct rigorous back-testing and validation of models, ensuring their robustness and alignment with regulation and market conditions.
Data Analysis & Interpretation: Analyze large datasets to identify trends, relationships, and patterns. Work with financial and market data to derive insights for model improvement and validation.
Process Optimization: Analyze process workflow and advise on improvements to facilitate experience in model application, maintenance, and internal and regulatory reporting.
Research & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest research in quantitative finance, machine learning, and statistical techniques. Apply new methodologies and tools to improve existing models and develop new strategies.


Let's Talk About You


You have a Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Business or Financial Engineering / Economics or Computer Science.
You have between 2 and 5 years of experience in quantitative modeling and/or validation, preferably in financial services, with hands-on experience with programming languages such as Python, R, Matlab or SAS/SQL.
You demonstrate understanding of business processes, regulatory requirements, internal control risk management, process, data and technology controls and related standards and frameworks.
You are fluent in English and Dutch or French.


Soft Skills


Quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills, with high capacity for solving challenging business problems
Present complex quantitative concepts and findings in a clear and accessible manner to stakeholders at various levels of technical expertise.
Strong analytical thinking and a drive for continuous learning and improvement, tech-savvy
Ability to work in a collaborative, team-based environment


How will you grow?


You will further develop your expertise across a broad range of quantitative applications in risk.
As you grow, you will be given more responsibility to manage assignments working directly with senior members of our client teams and guide junior colleagues.
As you become proficient in various skill sets, you will coach your colleagues and continue to enhance your management competencies.


Our story

Our Risk, Regulatory & Forensic practice is a global leader in helping clients manage risk and uncertainty from the boardroom to the network. We provide a broad array of services that allow our clients around the world to better measure, manage and control risk to enhance the reliability of systems and processes throughout their organization.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:


My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities


Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements remains essential in today's reality:


Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.


Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

Title: Implementation Data Science Engineer
Description:
Job Description

About Robovision

Robovision provides the industrial backbone for vision intelligence, delivering a governed infrastructure that transforms how global enterprises scale. By shifting from abstract AI probability to Outcome Assurance, we empower manufacturers to convert human quality expertise into a permanent digital asset. Our architecture is designed to eliminate dependency on manual intervention and specialized data science silos, ensuring Institutional Autonomy across global production lines.

Headquartered in Ghent, Belgium, our infrastructure safeguards hundreds of millions in annual revenue for OEMs and Tier-1 manufacturers. We operate with a "partnership-first" mindset, moving beyond traditional hierarchies to deliver institutional autonomy and the lowest total cost of ownership over decades. At Robovision, we don’t just build tools, we architect the foundation for industrial reliability.

What You'll Do

At Robovision, our Implementation Experts sit at the heart of how we deliver our industrial vision platform to customers. You won't just help build models—you'll own project outcomes.


Together with the Solution Architect and the Product manager, you translate the technical complexities of new projects into realistic effort estimates and timelines.
Once a project kicks off, you deliver the agreed scope by understanding the customer's operational needs and delivering algorithms that genuinely improve their workflows.
You collaborate with quality engineers to ensure development stays aligned with the required guidelines and standards.
You take real ownership of your work, knowing that what you ship has a direct impact on the people using it.
You will work together with R&D and our platform teams to stay on top of the latest developments, both in the world and on our platform
You are able to act as a trainer, and to share your knowledge of platform features with customers through documentation and or training
By sharing your feedback with Product Managers, you help to improve our platform.


Job Requirements

What You Bring


Data science holds few secrets for you. Through education, experience, or both, you know what it takes to build great AI - and you keep pushing until you get the best out of the available data.
You think in Python. Clean architecture and solid documentation aren't afterthoughts for you — they're part of the job.
You're comfortable engaging with domain experts and customers who will challenge you with complex, real-world problems.
You deploy with containers. That's just how it's done.
Strong written and spoken English. It makes collaboration with international customers and partners a lot smoother.
You’re based in Belgium.


Nice to have


You stay current with developments in AI through your own channels and curiosity.
You've worked alongside software development teams and know how to bridge the gap between model output and user-facing design.
You're genuinely motivated by the idea of working with technology that has a tangible impact on the people who use it.
Knowledge of Dutch is considered to be an asset.


What We Offer

Joining Robovision means securing a front-row seat in Belgium’s most ambitious industrial AI scale-up, where the environment is as dynamic as the technology we develop. We provide a sophisticated entrepreneurial ecosystem designed for high-impact leaders, offering unmatched opportunities for accelerated professional evolution across multiple strategic domains. This is a role for those who thrive on ownership and are ready to turn personal ambition into industrial-scale results by architecting the global scaling of our organization.

Our culture is built on transparency and a partnership-first mindset, moving beyond traditional hierarchies to focus on high-level communication and collective success. We are a team of owners who celebrate shared success and foster an environment of high ambition, technical excellence, and respect. By joining this high-performance ecosystem, you contribute to a governed infrastructure that prioritizes long-term outcome assurance over short-term hype, ensuring your work delivers a permanent impact on the industrial landscape.

Our recruitment team is on summer break until August 10th. Please note that applications and feedback will be processed after our return. Thank you for your patience, and have a great summer!

Title: Junior Data Scientist
Description:
About XTEL

XTEL is a leading global revenue management solutions provider for consumer goods companies (CPG). We help our clients' businesses grow smarter, every day, through our holistic and proven digitalisation and change management approach. By combining state-of-the-art technology, deep industry expertise, and a proven approach to data and change management, XTEL's Revenue Management suite supports CPGs towards value realisation and profitable revenue growth.




Position Overview

The Junior Data Scientist supports the design and delivery of analytics and machine learning solutions by working with complex datasets, building tailored models, and contributing to scalable data pipelines. The role collaborates closely with technical, functional, product, and client stakeholders to develop robust solutions and help standardize analytics practices across projects.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze and preprocess complex data sets from various sources to prepare them for analytics solutions.
Develop, implement, and fine-tune machine learning models tailored to specific project needs.
Collaborate with the team to build robust and scalable data pipelines.
Participate in client meetings to discuss technical results and gather feedback.
Work together with the functional team involved in the project, including business experts and the project manager.
Work together with the product team to integrate developed solutions into our products.
Document processes and contribute to the standardization of analytics solutions.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in STEM fields, such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related disciplines.
1-2 years of work experience in Data Science and Analytics.
Knowledge for Data Science, including Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Operations Research.
knowledge of Python and main Machine Learning frameworks, such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with object-oriented programming.
Experience in developing, validating, and tuning Machine Learning models.
Experience with cloud services to store data, build automated pipelines, and run analytics or machine learning solutions.
Experience with Databricks.
Familiarity with development tools such as VSCode or other IDEs, and Jupyter notebooks.
Knowledge of Git, including push, pull, fetch, and merge.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex results clearly.
Analytical skills with a critical thinking attitude.
Proficient in English.

Nice to have:

Experience with SQL for data manipulation and analysis.

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

AI- & ML-solution development


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



De job in een notendop

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, ...(zie verantwoordelijkheden).

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (Engels en Nederlands of Frans).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Wat full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Data Scientist (Senior)
Description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data & Analytics team. As a Data Scientist you will not only bring technical expertise but also a deep understanding of business operations and strategy. Your work will directly influence decision-making and help shape the future of our organization through actionable insights drawn from complex datasets.

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business leaders, product managers, and engineers, to design and implement data-driven solutions that align with the company’s goals. You will be expected to translate complex data into business value, leveraging machine learning, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.

Key Responsibilities:


Business Insight Development: Understand the key business challenges and opportunities, and use data to develop solutions that align with strategic objectives.
Data Strategy: Collaborate with leadership to define the data science roadmap and priorities based on business needs and opportunities.
Predictive Modeling & Machine Learning: Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models to forecast trends, optimize processes, and drive business outcomes.
Data Analysis & Visualization: Analyze large, complex datasets to extract actionable insights, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Data science pipeline: Advise, build and continuously improve the data science pipeline which best responds to team.blue analytics needs.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with business leaders, product teams, and engineers to ensure that data solutions meet business requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest trends in data science, AI, and machine learning to continuously improve the team’s capabilities.



Requirements:


Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data science, with a proven track record of solving complex business problems using data.
Strong understanding of business operations and the ability to align data science projects with business objectives.
Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical insights into business recommendations and communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
Problem-solving: Strong analytical thinking with the ability to handle complex and unstructured data.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
Experience with SQL and working with large data sets.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).



"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

Title: Senior Data Science Analyst - OptimusAI
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Science Specialist, you’ll collaborate in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3–6 experts, using your creativity and analytics expertise to drive client performance in areas like energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You’ll work side-by-side with client process engineers and analytics specialists, presenting your insights directly to executive audiences.

Internally, you’ll partner with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms that address both current and future client needs. You’ll play a key role in codifying best practices, amplifying our impact both inside and outside the firm, and shaping the product roadmap.

You’ll be based in our Brussels office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution, OptimusAI, which sits at the intersection of three practices: Global Energy and Materials, QuantumBlack, and Operations.

Global Energy and Materials: Advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.

QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey: The AI arm of our firm, helping clients transform faster, innovate smarter, and anticipate the future.

Operations: Assists clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing strategies and solutions for their most critical problems—connecting boardroom strategies to shop floor operators.

At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics. We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in plant control rooms, optimize process control systems, and unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.

OptimusAI also supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying our approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You’ll benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. Experience unparalleled career growth, with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. Plus, seize the opportunity to travel to client sites—locally and around the world.

There is a flexibility to hire at different role level, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics, ideally within heavy industry environments
Advanced Python programming skills, with a passion for writing clean, efficient, modular, and maintainable code
Proven ability to implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for seamless model integration and deployment
Strong DevOps and backend engineering capabilities, including experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Self-starter with excellent organizational abilities—able to independently initiate tasks and drive them to completion
Skilled in making rational, data-driven decisions based on facts and logical reasoning
Ability to create high-quality work products, such as PowerPoint presentations, Excel models, articles, or other written outputs
Exceptional time management skills to thrive in a complex, largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to work or attend meetings outside traditional business hours, and to take on projects at short notice when needed
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences and seniority levels

Work in an agile way and adapt to changing business needs

Fluent in English. Fluency in Dutch is a big plus

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist/MLOps




About Exsolvæ




Exsolvæ is a Brussels-based Data & AI consultancy. Our activity is structured around three main areas: Data Foundations, Data Science & AI, and BI & Analytics.

We build data systems that run in production for Belgian enterprises across finance, pharma, insurance, retail and energy.




We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist/MLOps Engineer to join Exsolvæ and work on projects centered on forecasting, pricing analytics and GenAI-driven use cases.




What we look for?

Analytical depth: proven experience designing and validating machine learning models, from proof-of-concept through production rollout.
An engineering mindset: comfortable owning the reliability, versioning and deployment of what you build, not just the modelling.
Clear communication: ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.




The Role

You will work at the intersection of data science and engineering, driving the development and operationalisation of advanced analytics and machine learning solutions. This position is weighted more heavily toward implementation and MLOps than pure proof-of-concept work: you'll find the right balance between data science and data engineering and collaborate closely with business stakeholders and technical teams in an Agile setting.




What will you do?

MLOps & Engineering

Design, develop and maintain production-ready data and ML pipelines using PySpark on Databricks.
Manage experiment tracking, model versioning, and lifecycle management using MLflow.
Ensure code quality, reproducibility, and maintainability through Git-based version control and software engineering best practices.
Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy and scale models from proof-of-concept to production.




Data Science & Analytics

Conduct advanced data analytics, including causal inference, ad hoc analyses and exploratory data work to generate business insights.
Build and validate tabular machine learning models (classification, regression, forecasting) to support business decision-making.
Develop forecasting models and impact models to support pricing and commercial strategies.
Structure and execute data preparation and feature engineering workflows to support model experimentation and production rollouts.
Contribute to GenAI and LLM-based initiatives where relevant, including structured data extraction, multimodal pipelines and computer vision use cases.




Stakeholder Communication

Translate complex analytical results into clear, concise outputs for business stakeholders.
Define requirements and validate proof-of-concepts together with business and technical partners prior to production rollout.
Present findings and recommendations in a structured, actionable manner.




The technical stack

Data processing & ML: PySpark, Databricks.
Experiment tracking & lifecycle: MLflow.
Cloud: Azure.
Version control: Git.
Languages: Python (primary).




The Mindset we are looking for

You take end-to-end ownership, from model design to production deployment.
You adapt your communication to your audience, technical or business.
You sit with the business as comfortably as you sit with the data.
You stay rigorous: you validate before you ship.
You flag problems early rather than silently absorbing them.




Profile & Experience

Proven experience in a senior Data Scientist or MLOps role in a corporate environment.
Strong hands-on experience with PySpark and Databricks for data processing and ML workflows.

Description:
Description

Vous jouez un rôle central dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique avancées, favorisant l’innovation et l’automatisation au sein de l’organisation.

Vous collaborez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour tirer parti des services d’IA dans le cloud, de l’IA générative et d’une infrastructure d’apprentissage automatique évolutive.

Vous veillez à ce que les modèles d’IA soient robustes, éthiques et alignés sur les objectifs commerciaux.

Votre job en deux mots

Principales responsabilités :

Développement de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique :

Déploiement de modèles d’apprentissage automatique et d’apprentissage profond (y compris l’IA générative) pour résoudre des problèmes métier complexes.

Optimisation des modèles en termes de performance, d’évolutivité et de rentabilité dans les environnements cloud Azure.

Mise en œuvre de pipelines MLOps pour automatiser l’entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles.

Infrastructure cloud et d’IA :

Développement et maintenance d’une infrastructure d’IA évolutive sur les plateformes cloud Azure, en utilisant des services tels qu’Azure ML et AKS.

Garantie de déploiements d’IA sécurisés, conformes et hautement disponibles dans le cloud. IA générative et innovation.

Explorer et intégrer des modèles d'IA générative (LLM, etc.) pour des applications telles que : RAG (Real Agile Agile), traitement intelligent de documents, transcription vocale et IA conversationnelle.

Anticiper les tendances en IA (par exemple, le fine-tuning, l'IA multimodale) et proposer des cas d'usage innovants.

Gouvernance des données et des modèles

Garantir la qualité des données, la réduction des biais et le respect des pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA lors du développement des modèles.

Mettre en œuvre des outils de surveillance et d'explicabilité des modèles afin de suivre leurs performances et leur conformité.

Collaboration et mobilisation des parties prenantes

Collaborer avec les équipes produit, les data scientists et les parties prenantes métier pour identifier les opportunités offertes par l'IA.

Traduire les besoins métier en solutions techniques d'IA et communiquer efficacement les résultats obtenus.

Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Mais vous pouvez en devenir un, parmi nous. Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants:


Un master ou un doctorat en sciences, avec d'excellents résultats académiques dans des domaines techniques (économétrie, informatique, intelligence artificielle, etc.).
Une expertise en
techniques d'apprentissage automatique et la volonté de maintenir vos connaissances à jour ; une connaissance approfondie d'algorithmes tels que les forêts
aléatoires, les réseaux de neurones et l'apprentissage par renforcement est indispensable.
GenAI : ingénierie rapide, résultats structurés, etc. (voir les responsabilités).
De solides compétences en programmation Python et SQL.
Une excellente maîtrise du néerlandais ou du français, avec des notions de l'autre langue, et de l'anglais.
Une expérience dans la vulgarisation d'analyses complexes auprès d'un public non technique, grâce à vos talents de conteur et votre capacité à visualiser les données. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, tant sur le plan technique que commercial.
Une soif d'apprendre, non seulement pour maîtriser de nouveaux algorithmes et technologies, mais aussi sur le plan relationnel ; vous êtes conscient(e) que la valeur de votre travail repose sur la qualité et l'acceptation, et vous souhaitez travailler sur ces deux aspects.
Des compétences exceptionnelles en résolution de problèmes : vous savez qu'une bonne compréhension d'un problème représente au moins 90 % de la solution ; vous faites preuve de créativité et de persévérance pour comprendre les problèmes et trouver des solutions.


Un plus :


Bilinguisme (anglais et néerlandais ou français).
Expérience en développement de produits de données, de la conception à la production.
Compétences en développement full-stack.
Connaissance du cloud, de préférence Azure.



Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :


Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

Title: AI Developer
Description:
Most AI applications generate answers. Arch*i turns medical knowledge into personalised health guidance.




At erudite.health we are building Arch*i: a health platform that brings together medical knowledge, technology and artificial intelligence.




It starts from an extensive medical intake and turns that into personal guidance on nutrition, movement, mental health and supplementation.




Not generic output. The decision logic is clinically grounded and validated before it reaches a user.

To the user it feels simple. Underneath sits a technically demanding system, where medical reliability and engineering quality are the same requirement.




You join on validated foundations. What exists today, you take through to completion and launch.




As an AI Developer, you help build the intelligence behind that platform.




What will you build?

You help build the AI engine behind Arch*i: the system that turns a medical intake into personalised, evidence-based health guidance.




Your work includes:

The complete path from medical intake to personalised, well-founded guidance.
Translating clinical decision logic into reliable, production-ready software.
Building data pipelines that process health data correctly, securely and reproducibly.
AI functionality that returns information with source and context, rather than a plausible-sounding guess.
Testing, evaluation and guardrails: demonstrating that it holds up before it goes live.
Monitoring and improving models in production, on quality, drift and cost.
The full development lifecycle, from concept and implementation to deployment and follow-up.




Who are you?

You are an AI Developer who enjoys building software that goes beyond demos and prototypes.




You also recognise yourself in the following:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or equivalent through experience.
At least two years of experience with Python and building production-ready software.
Experience with LLMs and/or RAG, or the motivation to quickly deepen your expertise there.
You write clean, well-tested code and think in systems rather than isolated scripts.
You are curious, think critically and keep digging until you fully understand the underlying problem.
You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English.




Nice to have:

Experience with computer vision or image processing.
Familiarity with MLOps: deployment, monitoring and evaluation of models.
An interest in healthcare, life sciences or medical technology.
Knowledge of GDPR and privacy regulation around health data.




Why join Arch*i and erudite.health?

Behind Arch*i stands erudite.health, a Belgian health group developing science-based health solutions. The group builds brands such as Nutriphyt, Trenker and Alline, and invests in innovative digital health platforms. Medical expertise, science and technology form the foundation of everything we build.




An environment where you can grow

Arch*i keeps evolving. What you build today becomes part of the intelligence behind personalised health guidance.




You work closely with engineering, design and our clinical team, with room to deepen your expertise in LLMs, RAG, computer vision and MLOps, in an environment where quality and reliability come first.




Flexibility

Full-time permanent contract.
40-hour working week with 12 additional leave days (ADV).
Flexible working hours.
Two fixed remote working days after your onboarding period.




Salary and benefits

Gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €4,900, depending on your experience and expertise.
Company car with charging card is negotiable.
Meal vouchers worth €8 per working day.
Monthly net expense allowance of €100.
Eco vouchers worth €250 per year.
Sector premium and year-end bonus.
Hospitalisation insurance, with the possibility of adding family members.
Attractive bicycle allowance if you commute by bike.
Employee discount on erudite.health products.
Laptop.
Flexible benefits plan (cafeteria plan).




Application process

We like to keep our recruitment process clear and efficient.




You start with an introductory conversation where we get to know each other and tell you more about erudite.health, Arch*i and the role. This is followed by a technical interview with several future colleagues, complemented by a technical assignment.




If there is a strong mutual fit, we will make you a concrete offer and hopefully welcome you to erudite.health soon.




Interested? Send your CV to recruitment@erudite.health. Do you have questions about the role or about erudite.health first? We are happy to help.




At erudite.health, we believe talent is defined by people, not by background. That is why we welcome every candidate who sees themselves in this role.
