Title: Machine Learning & Operations Research Specialist
Description:
bpost strives to create an inclusive environment with challenging projects and inspiring collaborations. With our colleagues at the heart of our organisation, we believe in careers rather than jobs. As part of the international group bnode, bpost has transitioned from the Belgian postal operator to a regional and digital expert in parcel size logistics. With a focus on social and environmental sustainability, our people are the foundation of everything we do. We foster a culture that supports diversity, inclusion and career growth, ensuring that every team member has the opportunity to thrive and succeedWhat will you do?

Bpost is looking for a Data Scientist / Operations Research Specialist with proven experience building and industrializing machine learning and optimization solutions.

In Belgium, Bpost operates in a context of structural mail decline, continued parcel growth, increasing operational variability, and strong competitive pressure. Better forecasting and optimization are therefore key to improving service (quality) and network efficiency (cost) across sorting, transport and distribution.

In this role, you will design, prototype and industrialize analytical solutions that drive operational and tactical decisions across Bpost’s network. This includes building robust decision-support tools such as forecasting and optimization models, and ensuring they are deployed, monitored and used in real operations.

You will work closely with operational stakeholders and IT teams to turn business problems into scalable, production-ready solutions. You will also help increase the analytics maturity of Bpost by moving use cases from ad hoc analysis or prototype stage toward robust, reusable and business-embedded analytical products.

Who are you?


At least 5 years of proven experience using both machine learning and operations research to solve real-world problems
At least 5 years of proven experience designing, prototyping, deploying, and monitoring models in production environments
Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic analytical solutions
Interest in logistics, supply chain, and physical network decision-making
Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Full proficiency in English. French and Dutch are a strong plus.


Tools & Technologies (Indicative Stack)


Programming & analytics: Python, SQL, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn
ML & forecasting: XGBoost, LightGBM, time series models
Optimization: OR-Tools, Gurobi or similar solvers
Engineering: Git, Airflow, Docker, CI/CD tooling
Versioning & experimentation: MLflow, DVC, Weights & Biases, or similar
Platforms: Conveyor, Databricks, Spark, Snowflake-connected environments, or similar cloud-based platforms
AI & agentic systems: familiarity with LLM-based applications, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, or similar emerging technologies for decision support and workflow automation


What We Provide


The opportunity to create tangible impact at national scale by improving services that are used every day by millions of people, households, and businesses across Belgium
High-visibility analytical challenges at the intersection of machine learning, optimization, and real-world operations


What do we offer?

Like a Long-awaited Parcel, We Want To Make You Feel Welcome And Valued. Our Offer Includes a Competitive Monthly Salary, That Goes Without Saying. On Top Of That, You Can Count On


Meal vouchers of €8 per working day
Hospitalization-, group- and disability insurances
A phone subscription, including 25GB data
A flexible renumeration plan, which allows you to customize your own benefits. A company car, bike leasing, public transportation, extra days off,... the choice is yours
Possibility to enter the Federal Mobility plan
Work/life balance, thanks to flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home
20 days of statutory leave and 7 additional extralegal days off
An end-of-year and performance-based bonus and double holiday pay
Many benefits from more than 100 Bpost-partners

As an AI & Data Engineer at iO, you are first and foremost an experienced software engineer who builds, integrates, and operationalizes AI and data solutions within clients’ existing IT ecosystems.

You will work on a wide variety of AI challenges: from intelligently leveraging or fine-tuning Large Language Models, agent and multi-agent setups, and applying RAG patterns, to building ETL pipelines that feed a data platform. A recurring pattern in your work is integrating existing cloud services and APIs into an efficient, scalable, and reliable solution. The focus lies on building production-grade systems that function correctly within complex, often enterprise-level IT landscapes.

Prompt engineering is an art form to you. You think creatively about how to achieve the best results, while paying attention to preventing hallucinations and implementing smart guardrails. You evaluate your solutions systematically to gain insight into output quality.

In your work, you will encounter many forms of AI: from statistical models to Large Language Models, from Generative AI in the domains of image, video, and audio to Natural Language Processing. The emphasis is mainly on applying and integrating existing models and services, and building the infrastructure around them.

You will work on a wide range of client challenges: from automatically analyzing documents to detecting events in audio or video data, building agents and orchestration solutions, generating graphical output based on data, or creating and validating content. Wherever AI can add value, you design and implement the complete solution as an engineer.

You collaborate with various AI experts within iO and with technical teams on the client side. Your solutions are based on modern (cloud) platforms, SaaS services, and programming languages such as TypeScript and Python.

What Are Your Responsibilities as an AI & Data Engineer?


Designing AI & Data solutions: Analyze client challenges related to AI and data and define solutions, approaches, and architecture
Software engineering & integration: Develop backend components, APIs, and services to ensure AI solutions integrate seamlessly with existing applications and platforms
Data Pipeline Development: Design and build robust ETL/ELT processes and real-time data streams
Data Platform Architecture: Set up modern data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms
AI Integration: Implement machine learning pipelines and integrate AI services into data workflows
Data Quality & Governance: Ensure data quality, security, and compliance within data ecosystems
Performance Optimization: Optimize data processing performance and scalability
Cloud Data Services: Work with cloud-native data services such as AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Dataflow
Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring and alerting for data pipelines and AI workloads


Your Qualities And Skills As AI & Data Engineer


You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a focus on software engineering
You have several years of experience as a software engineer and have worked on data- and/or AI-driven systems in a professional, preferably enterprise, environment
You have experience with different LLM architectures and understand the strengths and weaknesses of various AI solutions
You are familiar with the principles of modern data architectures, data modeling, and big data processing
You are proficient in modern data processing languages such as Python and SQL, and have experience with frameworks such as Apache Spark, Pandas, or Dask
You are familiar with AWS or Azure cloud data platforms
You have a strong foundation in software engineering, including knowledge of CI/CD, unit testing, Git (flow), secure development, error handling, asynchronous operations, and real-time data streams
You are able to translate your ideas into technical architecture diagrams, data flow schemas, and documentation, while also clearly explaining your solutions to less technical stakeholders (clients and colleagues)
You enjoy sparring with colleagues about ideas and solutions and working collaboratively to achieve better results

Title: VIE – Data Scientist & Data Analyst (H/F) – Belgique
Description:
Contexte et environnement

Au sein de TotalEnergies Charging Solutions Belgium (TCSB), filiale de la branche Marketing & Services de TotalEnergies, l'entité Data intervient sur les activités d'analyse de données, de data science et de transformation des plateformes de données pour les activités de recharge de véhicules électriques.

L'équipe Data accompagne les besoins métiers de la filiale depuis l'identification des cas d'usage jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de solutions analytiques et prédictives, en passant par la collecte, l'exploitation et la valorisation des données.

Vérifiez votre éligibilité au programme ainsi que les spécificités pays sur le site internet : https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/qu-est-ce-que-le-volontariat-international

Merci de candidater en anglais.

Activités

Vos principales missions :

Développement de modèles prédictifs et de solutions Data Science


Participer à la création de modèles prédictifs appliqués aux activités de recharge pour véhicules électriques.
Exploiter et analyser des données afin d'optimiser l'implantation des bornes de recharge, les coûts d'installation et les opérations de maintenance.
Exploiter et analyser des volumes importants de données internes et externes.
Développer de nouvelles solutions Data Science.



Migration et transformation des plateformes de données


Accompagner les projets de migration de plateformes et de transformation des environnements de données.
Développer et adapter des traitements, dashboards, modèles analytiques et solutions de reporting pour les équipes métier.
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'architecture data locale et à la structuration des flux de données.
Développer des modèles analytiques, des outils de visualisation et des solutions de reporting à destination des équipes métiers.
Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles belges ainsi qu'avec les équipes Data et Digital du siège afin de répondre aux besoins métiers et d'accompagner les évolutions des outils.



Le poste combine des activités Data Analysis (50%) et Data Scientist Analysis (50%), centré sur l'analyse de données, la modélisation prédictive et la transformation des plateformes data dans le domaine de la mobilité électrique.

Profil du candidat

Diplômé d'un Bac+5 minimum en Data Science, Data Engineering, (école de commerce ou université.)

Vous bénéficiez d'une première expérience en Data Science, Data Analytics.

La connaissance du secteur de l'énergie constitue un atout.

Vous disposez de compétences en :


Databricks ;
Snowflake ;
Clustering ;
Segmentation ;
Scoring ;



Vous maîtrisez les outils suivants :


Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) ;
SQL ;
Modèles de Machine Learning (Modélisation prédictive).



Un niveau d'anglais B2/C1 est requis. Un niveau de français C1 minimum est également demandé. La connaissance du néerlandais constitue un atout.

Informations supplémentaires

Date de début : Q4 2026

TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
An exciting opportunity for a skilled Data Scientist to join a dynamic team focused on advancing the field of biopharmaceutical manufacturing. This role will involve collaborating with various functions within the organization to drive innovation and excellence in data science applications related to drug substance manufacturing processes. You will play a crucial role in supporting the development and optimization of key processes and methodologies.

Responsibilities


Provide advanced statistical and data science support across multiple functions, including cell culture, purification, and analytical activities.
Engage in process optimization, investigation, comparability studies, monitoring, method transfer, validation, and characterization.
Contribute to the preparation of protocols and reports with significant statistical content through data collection, experiment design, and data analysis.
Ensure the traceability and correctness of collected data, facilitating timely information exchange with relevant stakeholders.
Maintain compliance with legal standards and regulations, ensuring high-quality scientific and technical documentation.



Technical Skills


Proficient in statistical data analysis and data science techniques.
Experience working in a cGMP environment, with a strong understanding of regulatory guidelines.
Domain knowledge in biologics, particularly in upstream or downstream development and manufacturing.
Ability to lead complex technical projects effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills with a change agent mentality to propose innovative solutions to scientific challenges.



Profile


Holds a Bachelor's degree in data sciences, statistics, or a related discipline with a minimum of 6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry; or a Master's degree with at least 4 years of experience; or a Ph.D. with a minimum of 2 years of experience.
Demonstrates effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for cross-functional collaboration, particularly in English. Proficiency in Dutch is advantageous.
A team player capable of working autonomously in a collaborative, dynamic environment.



Practical Information


This position is based at a biopharmaceutical manufacturing site near Geel.
Fluent English is required, and proficiency in Dutch is a plus.
This is a long-term opportunity available for both consultants on our payroll and freelance professionals.



Contactperson & Reference


Reference #: INCA26907

Title: Data Scientist - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Shape the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)

Are you an early-career professional excited to harness the power of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is seeking a Data Scientist - Gen AI to join our innovative team in Brussels. Our Belgian team specializes in LLM and GenAI projects, and this is your chance to work on cutting-edge solutions, collaborate with top-tier experts, and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment.

Who You Are

A recent graduate or professional with 1 to 3 years of experience, with hands-on experience working with LLMs and a passion for generative AI and NLP. Motivated to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges in AI. Able to thrive in collaborative settings while independently driving your own workstreams. Eager to learn, grow, and push the boundaries of what's possible in AI innovation.

Who We Are

Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm operating at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we help clients across industries—public health, manufacturing, etc. —leverage generative AI to achieve transformative outcomes. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. At Artefact, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusivity and employee growth.

What You Will Do


Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools.
Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications.
Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems.
Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions.
Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools.
Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions.


What You Bring


A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI).
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries.
Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI.
Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus.
A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.


What We Offer


A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals.
Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects.
A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development.
Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields.
A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.


This position is based in Brussels.

Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Senior Applied Data Scientist
Description:
Company Overview

team.blue is the market leader in enabling digital success for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) across Europe, catering to over 3 million customers in 25+ languages. Our mission is to make online business success simpler, by providing our customers with all the tools and resources they need to excel online and remain ahead of the curve.

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Applied Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of AI, product thinking, and innovation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing Data Science & ML algorithms to solve complex, real-world business problems across the team.blue group. This role requires strong analytical skills, programming, problem solving and data wrangling skills, good communication abilities, and up-to-date knowledge of the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments.

Responsibilities:


Break down multi-domain business problems with a strong focus on return on investment and impact metrics, and think through the appropriate technical methods from POC to production
Develop solutions and extract insight from data using data science and classical machine learning methods and generative AI (GenAI)
Take ownership of developing, implementing, and automating robust data science and ML models and pipelines, including feature generation, modeling, evaluation, retraining and deployment
Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative Data Science/ML/AI solutions
Conduct research on the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments and apply them to improve our systems
Document processes, code, and findings for future reference and knowledge sharing



Required Skills:


8+ years hands-on industry experience solving data science and machine learning problems to address real-world business problems across multiple verticals
Expert programming skills in Python and SQL and with relevant Data Science & ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, etc)
Ability to think through problems from fundamental principles and operate with a high degree of independence and autonomy while bringing clarity to under-specified problems
Deep understanding of statistical and ML algorithms, methodologies and approaches ranging from SVMs to deep learning & LLMs
Ability to own the end to end of the lifecycle of ML/AI projects from conception to containerization
History of hands-on ownership & implementer of projects that have been put in production and made an impact
Experience in applying statistical concepts (e.g. regressions, A/B tests, clustering, probability) to business problems
Strong problem-solving skills with excellent verbal & written communication and the ability to craft analysis into well-written and persuasive content
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams



Nice to have skills


Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related fields.
Deep understanding of current DataOps & MLOps practices, deploying and monitoring models and ETL (extract, transform and load) pipelines
Experience with AI/ML R&D
Experience across startups and enterprise firms
Experience with distributed data tools (e.g. Spark, Dask, Apache Arrow), observability frameworks (OTel)



"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

team.blue is a leading digital enabler for companies and entrepreneurs. It serves over 3.3 million customers in Europe and has more than 3,000 experts to support them. Its goal is to shape technology and to empower businesses with innovative digital services.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing Data Science & ML algorithms to solve complex, real-world business problems across the team.blue group. This role requires strong analytical skills, programming, problem solving and data wrangling skills, good communication abilities, and up-to-date knowledge of the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments.

Responsibilities:

  • Break down multi-domain business problems with a strong focus on return on investment and impact metrics, and think through the appropriate technical methods from POC to production
  • Develop solutions and extract insight from data using data science and classical machine learning methods and generative AI (GenAI)
  • Take ownership of developing, implementing, and automating robust data science and ML models and pipelines, including feature generation, modeling, evaluation, retraining and deployment
  • Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative Data Science/ML/AI solutions
  • Conduct research on the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments and apply them to improve our systems
  • Document processes, code, and findings for future reference and knowledge sharing


Required Skills:

  • 8+ years hands-on industry experience solving data science and machine learning problems to address real-world business problems across multiple verticals
  • Expert programming skills in Python and SQL and with relevant Data Science & ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, etc)
  • Ability to think through problems from fundamental principles and operate with a high degree of independence and autonomy while bringing clarity to under-specified problems
  • Deep understanding of statistical and ML algorithms, methodologies and approaches ranging from SVMs to deep learning & LLMs
  • Ability to own the end to end of the lifecycle of ML/AI projects from conception to containerization
  • History of hands-on ownership & implementer of projects that have been put in production and made an impact
  • Experience in applying statistical concepts (e.g. regressions, A/B tests, clustering, probability) to business problems
  • Strong problem-solving skills with excellent verbal & written communication and the ability to craft analysis into well-written and persuasive content
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams


Nice to have skills

  • Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related fields.
  • Deep understanding of current DataOps & MLOps practices, deploying and monitoring models and ETL (extract, transform and load) pipelines
  • Experience with AI/ML R&D
  • Experience across startups and enterprise firms
  • Experience with distributed data tools (e.g. Spark, Dask, Apache Arrow), observability frameworks (OTel)

Position Description

(Note: This job posting is only open to resident in Belgium , native French or Dutch . If this is not the case, please have a look at our other job postings instead!)

Do you enjoy working with data?

Are you skilled at identifying and solving problems? Are you comfortable using a variety of techniques in a fast-changing environment? Join our growing multidisciplinary innovation lab as a Senior Data Scientist.

Your role in our team

You support our clients within an innovation ecosystem and help shape their future data-driven strategies. You provide actionable insights using the latest concepts from the field of artificial intelligence. You develop machine learning algorithms that address current technological challenges. You also help clients visualize the information you generate, making it easy to share with stakeholders.

Thanks to your experience, you can translate the latest industry and IT trends into innovative solutions tailored to our clients’ operations. You participate in business development and sales processes to create new opportunities with existing or potential CGI clients. How You Strengthen Our Team

You are proactive and enjoy taking on challenges. With your expertise, you deliver the best solutions and identify those that offer the most value. You are also capable of mentoring and coaching your colleagues. You bring the following skills and experience:

A university degree (Bachelor or Master) with a strong statistical component, such as Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or Econometrics.

Proficiency in Python and/or R (pandas, tensorflow, scikit-learn, matplotlib).

Experience with advanced analytics, big data, and machine learning.

Knowledge of ML libraries for classification and regression (scikit-learn, keras, pytorch).

Familiarity with NLP libraries (SpaCy, NLPK, Stanford).

Proven experience solving complex challenges through data analysis and modeling.

At least 5 years of experience in the data domain.

Knowledge of Agile working methodologies.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google.

French-speaking with at least B2-level Dutch and strong English proficiency.

Be legally residing in Belgium

Considered as a Pre

Experience in software development / DevOps

Knowledge of computer vision techniques

Experience with Docker or Kubernetes

Familiarity with ML-OPS

Experience with Unity

Knowledge of Linked-Data

Why CGI?

CGI is one of the world's largest IT consultancy companies. Our people keep Belgium running. Government institutions, banks, infrastructure organization's, energy and utilities, manufacturing and life sciences companies are CGI's clients . We work on interesting projects that touch the everyday lives of millions of people. We have a regional presence, reinforced with global domain expertise, our ecosystem and colleagues spread across the globe.

We are proud of the impactful projects we make a success together with our colleagues.

At CGI, we value diversity and inclusion as it not only promotes collaboration, but also often leads to better results. We look forward to your contribution to our team!

Working in small self-managing teams consisting of experts in your field.


Directing your own career with the space to keep developing yourself.
You work with the latest technologies.

An immediate permanent contract
And the opportunity to become a CGI shareholder

Diplôme universitaire (Bachelor ou Master) avec une forte composante statistique, tel que mathématiques appliquées, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou Économétrie.

Maîtrise de Python et/ou R (pandas, tensorflow, scikit-learn, matplotlib).

Expérience en analytics avancés, big data et machine learning.

Connaissance des bibliothèques ML pour la classification et la régression (scikit-learn, keras, pytorch).

Connaissance des bibliothèques NLP (SpaCy, NLPK, Stanford).

Expérience avérée dans la résolution de problèmes complexes via l’analyse et la modélisation de données.

Connaissance des méthodes de travail Agile.

Expérience avec des plateformes cloud telles que Azure, AWS ou Google.

Déjà résider légalement en Belgique.

Expérience en développement logiciel / DevOps.

Connaissance des techniques de vision par ordinateur.

Expérience avec Docker ou Kubernetes.

Connaissance de ML-OPS.

Title: Senior Consultant in Data science
Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group born digital, augmented by data, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We partner with clients to resolve challenges and capitalize on opportunities. We believe that in today’s world of change and disruption, optimism is a force multiplier.





Job Description



As a Senior consultant in Data Science, you will be involved in transformation projects at our clients. You will execute project assignments in modelling and digital transformation (business/IT analysis and partial coding) environments with a good deal of business perspectives:



Machine learning, AI and statistics: developing predictive models of decision making (supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, econometrics, forecasting, quantitative diagnosis,...)
Operational research : assistance in the design and implementation of constraint optimization solutions and simulation models
Big Data : Algorithmic knowledge for large and unstructured data processing

You will get the opportunity to actively contribute to Sia’s internal activities:



Development and reinforcement of our offer, by understanding and interpreting data science innovation and challenges
Business development, by contributing to need definition and participating in our commercial initiatives

As fast as possible, you will take up team leadership roles and connect with colleagues of all levels.



Equipped with the entrepreneurial fibre, you are ready to cooperate in a fast growing company.







In return, you can expect:



An international company that gives importance to diversity, inclusion, employee well-being and corporate social responsibilities actions.
A great working atmosphere with friendly and professional colleagues where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
A personal development plan with a regular follow-up as well training opportunities to develop yourself
A competitive salary with great advantages, like mobility budget, hospital insurance, performance -related bonus,...


Qualifications


University Master Civil Engineer (applied mathematics, IT or similar)
2 to 6 years’ experience as a consultant
Outstanding team player with great interpersonal and communiction skills
Strong interest in data science and related sectors such as Energy and Finance
You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
Analytical mind, exploring options and able to synthesize into conclusions
Dynamic, result oriented, rigorous and committed
Trilingual: French, Dutch and English
Prepared to participate in temporary assignments abroad


Additional Information



We are unable to provide a work permit for this position



Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Title: Data & Simulation Specialist
Description:
Cartamundi is wereldmarktleider in “play”-oplossingen. Denk aan speelkaarten, kaart- en bordspellen, collectibles en trading card games.

Ons doel? “Live Different, Play Different” voor iedereen. Met bijna 3.000 mensen zetten we ons elke dag in om die ambitie waar te maken. Ons familiebedrijf, met hoofdkantoor in België, heeft daarvoor een wereldwijd netwerk van designcenters, verkoopkantoren en productiefaciliteiten. Een netwerk dat loopt van de VS en Brazilië tot Europa en Japan.

Cartamundi heeft een wereldwijde merkenportefeuille met heritage brands zoals Bicycle®, Bee®, Copag®, Shuffle® en heel wat lokaal geliefde merken. We zijn ook de vertrouwde partner van toonaangevende speelgoed- en entertainmentbedrijven voor productie- en distributieoplossingen.

De drukpersen van Cartamundi draaien al sinds 1765. We koppelen die rijke traditie aan innovatie in digitale en hybride speelervaringen. Om zo relevant te blijven – vandaag en morgen.

Cartamundi voert een strategie van duurzame en winstgevende groei. Op die manier streven we ernaar om onze planeet en ons bedrijf in topconditie te houden voor de komende generaties.




Lees meer op www.cartamundi.com

Volg ons op LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/cartamundi




Data & Simulation Analyst

Als Data & Simulation Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van complexe en unieke klantbehoeften naar correcte, efficiënte en productieklare collatieschema’s voor collectible kaartenproducten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat alle kaartvarianten in de juiste aantallen, samenstellingen en configuraties in flowpacks, decks en displays terechtkomen, in lijn met zowel klantverwachtingen als productietechnische mogelijkheden.




Jouw functie

Met jouw analytische blik en technische feeling…




…Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar haalbare oplossingen

Je analyseert klantwensen en adviseert op basis van technische en statistische inzichten.




…Ontwerp je collatieschema’s van A tot Z

Je ontwikkelt vorm-, lay‑out- en dropschema’s en zorgt voor correcte kaartcombinaties.
Je maakt scenario­berekeningen voor duidelijke keuzes en alternatieven.




…Lever je sterke simulaties en analyses

Je bouwt displaysimulaties op basis van kansberekening.
Je maakt impactanalyses en rapporten die beslissingen ondersteunen.




…Bewaak je data en kwaliteit

Je houdt namelists en control sheets up-to-date.
Je voert nauwkeurige 4‑eyes checks uit.




…Optimaliseer je tools en processen

Je verbetert bestaande tools en workflows en ondersteunt toolontwikkeling.




…Communiceer je vlot met interne partners

Je stemt af met Sales en productie en maakt technische info begrijpelijk voor iedereen.




Jouw profiel

Je bent voor ons de ideale kandidaat omdat je…

Denkt op masterniveau en een wetenschappelijke of wiskundige achtergrond hebt.
Sterke analytische skills hebt en vaardig bent in statistische berekeningen.
Nauwkeurig werkt, een oog hebt voor detail en steeds gaat voor topkwaliteit (4 eyes mindset zit in jouw DNA).
Complexe materie helder kan uitleggen en graag meedenkt in oplossingen.
Uitblinkt in Excel. Basis tot programmeervaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
De taal van zowel Sales als Productie begrijpt en deze werelden moeiteloos met elkaar verbindt.
Proactief verbeterkansen ziet en graag werkt aan efficiëntere processen en slimmere tools.
Je jezelf vlot kan uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.




Aanbod

We bieden je de uitdaging om zelfstandig een boeiende en gevarieerde job uit te oefenen. Je komt terecht in een dynamische onderneming en een hecht team waar je kan werken in een aangename werksfeer. Je krijgt de mogelijkheden jezelf te ontwikkelen. Het salarispakket is in overeenstemming met je ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie.

Title: Machine learning engineer
Description:
BEDRIJF:




Deze Belgische SaaS-scale-up ontwikkelt een AI-platform dat de energiemarkt helpt om complexe operationele processen te digitaliseren en te automatiseren. Dankzij geavanceerde AI-technologie worden grote hoeveelheden data automatisch verwerkt tot bruikbare inzichten, waardoor klanten sneller, efficiënter en kwalitatiever kunnen werken. Het platform wordt vandaag wereldwijd ingezet door toonaangevende spelers binnen de energiesector en AI vormt er de absolute kern van het product. Je komt terecht in een engineeringgedreven omgeving waar jouw modellen niet in een proof of concept blijven hangen, maar rechtstreeks in productie draaien en een tastbare impact hebben op de verdere versnelling van de energietransitie.




De cultuur is uitgesproken customer-first en sterk teamgericht, met een vlakke organisatiestructuur waarin initiatief, ownership en samenwerking centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om ideeën aan te brengen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en mee richting te geven aan de verdere evolutie van een technologie die wereldwijd wordt ingezet en nog een enorm groeipotentieel kent.




JOBOMSCHRIJVING:




Als ML Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de volledige AI/ML-kant van het platform. Je ontwikkelt, traint en optimaliseert machine learning- en computer vision-modellen die rechtstreeks in productie worden ingezet en een directe impact hebben op de eindgebruikers. Je begeleidt het volledige traject: van datasetcreatie en experimenten tot modeltraining, validatie, deployment en monitoring in productie.




Daarnaast bouw je mee aan een performant MLOps-fundament met onder meer experiment tracking, versionering, deployment pipelines en model monitoring. Je denkt actief mee over de architectuur en de integratie van modellen binnen het SaaS-platform, zodat oplossingen niet alleen accuraat zijn, maar ook schaalbaar, performant en onderhoudbaar. Je werkt nauw samen met software engineers, product en operations in korte, pragmatische sprints, waarbij je veel autonomie krijgt en ownership neemt over projecten van idee tot productie. Hier bouw je geen proof of concepts, maar AI- oplossingen die dagelijks door internationale klanten worden gebruikt.




JOUW PROFIEL:




Masterprofiel.
Je hebt sterke ervaring met Python of een andere programmeertaal.
Staat open om full stack te developpen.
Je hebt aan ML-modellen gewerkt en deze in productie gebracht.
Je hebt ervaring met de volledige development cycle, datasetcreatie, trainen van modellen, testing, in productie zetten.
Je kan op architecturaal niveau meedenken, je weet hou je jouw model kan inpluggen in het SaaS-product.
Je bent pragmatisch en communicatief.
Je werkt vlot in het Engels.




UNIEK KARAKTER:




Bij dit bedrijf staat AI in het hart van het product. Je modellen gaan effectief live op echte data en bewegen de cijfers waar klanten en operationele teams om geven. Je groeit breed, van datasets en modelwerk over MLOps tot productintegratie, en je krijgt een strategische plek die mee bepaalt waar het bedrijf naartoe gaat. De omgeving is uitgesproken pragmatisch: de eenvoudige oplossing wanneer die werkt, de moeilijke wanneer het moet. Daarbovenop werk je aan een missie die telt, het versnellen van de transitie naar hernieuwbare energie.

Benieuwd naar meer?




Stuur nu jouw CV naar Gilles@cartiere.be en bel +32 3 343 94 93 voor meer informatie.

Bekijk onze website www.cartiere.be voor meer vacatures.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Company Description

Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 56.000 colleagues in 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together!

Job Description

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence. 

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who has:


A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related field.
Min. 2 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing AI/ML models in production environments.
Strong Python programming skills, including experience with API-building frameworks such as FastAPI and prototyping tools like Streamlit.
Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar is considered a strong asset.
Solid understanding of machine learning including model evaluation techniques and familiarity with advanced applications such as: NLP, forecasting, optimization, computer vision.
Experience in working with cloud-based environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ML pipelines is a strong asset.
Experience with Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and large language models, is a strong asset.
Hands-on knowledge of vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search) for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines is a strong asset.
Strong communication and business analysis skills and genuinely interested in understanding the customer’s business context and challenges.
You can explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible language to non-technical stakeholders.
A collaborative, open-minded mindset and a drive to keep learning in a fast-evolving field.
You're fluent in Dutch or French, as well as English.


What we can offer:


A dynamic role within OptimAI, a leading AI competence center focused on applied, impactful AI.
The opportunity to work on real-world projects across sectors, from logistics and government to healthcare and finance.
Access to expert colleagues, mentorship, and tailored learning opportunities to accelerate your growth.
A flexible hybrid work model and a strong focus on work-life balance.
A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement where your ideas and input are valued.


Additional Information

Our employees are known for making bold choices and delivering results. Work among high-level professionals at the forefront of corporate software solutions and innovation at Europe’s Leading Digital Service Provider.  

We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes:


A company car or mobility budget
Laptop, phone & phone subscription
A competitive salary and indefinite contract
Insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more
Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development


People are the cornerstone of our success. That’s why we aspire to be bolder together. Our goal is to build high-functioning teams and healthy team environments that inspire and help each other to deliver excellence for each of our customers.  

Excited about this job opportunity? Ready to shape the world with us? Great! We are looking forward to your application! 

At OptimAI, we combine the best of both worlds: data science and supply chain optimization. You will be part of a forward-thinking team where you can shape the future of data science and supply chain management. This is an excellent opportunity to make a real difference and grow your career in a field that is rapidly evolving and in high demand.

If you thrive on challenge, continuous learning, and want to make an impact in a fast-growing field, apply now to join the OptimAI Team.

______

Sopra Steria is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, ancestry, nationality, color, family or medical leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

Title: AI Engineer - AI Lab (kantoor Antwerpen)
Description:
Delen Private Bank is gespecialiseerd in discretionair vermogensbeheer en vermogensplanning. Onze missie? Het vermogen van onze klanten op een actieve en doordachte manier beheren en plannen, met het oog op een evenwichtige groei en een vlotte overdracht naar de volgende generaties. Persoonlijk contact, een langetermijnvisie en een duurzame aanpak kenmerken onze filosofie. Groep Delen is actief in vijf landen en telt meer dan 1000 medewerkers.




Het AI Lab binnen Delen Private Bank

De gedeelde missie van business, IT en het AI Lab is het vereenvoudigen en ondersteunen van processen, zodat collega’s minder administratieve lasten ervaren en meer tijd kunnen besteden aan persoonlijk contact met klanten en een uitstekende dienstverlening.




In het AI Lab luisteren we naar onze collega’s om hun uitdagingen in processen en werkmethoden te begrijpen, en verkennen we waar AI hen echt kan ondersteunen. Daarna bouwen we AI‑oplossingen om de meerwaarde voor onze collega’s concreet te maken. Wanneer die duidelijk is en er vraag ontstaat, neemt IT de oplossing over voor verdere uitwerking binnen onze systemen.




AI Engineer binnen het AI Lab

Als AI Engineer speel je een sleutelrol in het onderzoeken, ontwerpen en bouwen van AI‑oplossingen en capabilities die bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kwaliteit en schaalbaarheid van onze dienstverlening. Je opereert op het kruispunt van business, data, software engineering & AI.

Je bouwt end‑to‑end AI‑oplossingen: van data‑ingestion en modelontwikkeling tot concrete applicaties waarmee we de business versneld kunnen ondersteunen.
Wanneer een oplossing succesvol is en de business er klaar voor is, dragen we deze over aan IT voor volledige integratie. Onze rol is dan puur adviserend.
Je bouwt AI‑services die veilig, uitlegbaar en performant zijn, en je waakt over stabiliteit, monitoring en lifecycle management van modellen in productie.
Je denkt actief mee over architectuurkeuzes, herbruikbare componenten en best practices binnen het AI Lab.




Jouw profiel

Wat breng je high-level mee?

Minstens 2 jaar ervaring in een AI-, ML- of Software Engineering‑rol, waarbij je technische expertise combineert met een pragmatische, proactieve aanpak gericht op business value.

Jouw achtergrond & basis vaardigheden:

Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om technische concepten helder over te brengen aan business stakeholders
Gedrevenheid om waarde te leveren en collega’s te helpen
Diepgaande kennis van Python en solide softwareprincipes
Aantoonbare ervaring in het bouwen van LLM‑applicaties in een productieomgeving
Ervaring met Git en versiebeheer (GitHub)
Ervaring met Docker & GitHub Actions
Ervaring in data cleansing en feature engineering (Python & SQL)
Oog voor datakwaliteit en metadata‑management

Title: Data, Automation & AI Engineer
Description:
Waarom deze functie bestaat




Bij Bike Republic geloven we dat data, automatisering en artificiële intelligentie cruciale bouwstenen zijn om onze groei op een rendabele manier verder te zetten.

De afgelopen jaren investeerden we in een modern dataplatform met Azure, Databricks, Power BI en verschillende automatiseringen. Vandaag worden al tal van administratieve processen automatisch uitgevoerd zonder menselijke tussenkomst. De volgende stap is duidelijk: AI inzetten om processen slimmer, sneller en kwalitatief beter te maken.

Daarom zoeken we een Data, Automation & AI Engineer die mee bouwt aan de digitale toekomst van Bike Republic.




Jouw rol




Je bevindt je op het kruispunt van business, data, automatisering en AI.

Je analyseert hoe onze bedrijfsprocessen werken, begrijpt hoe data door onze systemen stroomt en vertaalt die kennis naar oplossingen die onze organisatie efficiënter maken.

Dat kan gaan van het bouwen van een Power BI-dashboard, over het opzetten van een Power Automate-flow, tot het ontwikkelen van een AI-oplossing die repetitieve taken overneemt of medewerkers ondersteunt in hun dagelijkse werk.




Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

﻿

Data Engineering & Reporting

Begrijpen van ERP-systemen en bedrijfsprocessen.
Integreren van data in onze Azure Data Lake omgeving.
Werken met Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SQL en API's.
Ontwikkelen van rapportering en dashboards in Power BI.
Vertalen van businessvragen naar bruikbare inzichten.




Process Automation

Detecteren van repetitieve administratieve taken.
Ontwerpen en bouwen van automatische workflows.
Werken met Microsoft Power Automate en andere integratietools.
Verbinden van verschillende systemen via API's en koppelingen.
Processen sneller, schaalbaarder en minder foutgevoelig maken.




AI & Digitale Innovatie

Onderzoeken hoe AI kan bijdragen aan onze operationele processen.
Implementeren van AI-oplossingen binnen de Microsoft-omgeving.
Toepassen van AI voor analyse, classificatie, voorspellingen, klantencommunicatie en procesondersteuning.
Experimenteren met nieuwe technologieën en deze vertalen naar concrete bedrijfswaarde.
Collega's inspireren en begeleiden in het gebruik van AI-tools.




IT & Technologie

Meedenken over de verdere uitbouw van onze data- en IT-architectuur.
Samenwerken met externe partners en consultants.
Interesse tonen in infrastructuur, hardware en bredere IT-vraagstukken.
Mee bouwen aan een technologisch vooruitstrevende organisatie.




Wie zoeken we?

Wij zoeken geen puur technisch profiel en ook geen klassieke business analyst.




We zoeken iemand die energie krijgt van het begrijpen van hoe een bedrijf werkt en die technologie gebruikt om processen te verbeteren. 




Ervaring van onderstaande tools zijn een plus, maar we geloven dat kennis de dag van vandaag snel kan vergaard worden:




Azure
Databricks
SQL
Power BI
Microsoft Power Automate
AI-tools en Microsoft Copilot
API-integraties
ERP-systemen
Microsoft 365




Belangrijker dan specifieke certificaten zijn:




analytisch denkvermogen
nieuwsgierigheid
ondernemerschap
probleemoplossend vermogen
passie voor technologie
de wil om continu bij te leren







Wat bieden we?




Je komt terecht in een klein maar ambitieus Data & IT-team bestaande uit een ervaren allround Data & IT Manager, externe dataspecialisten en IT-support.

Je krijgt de kans om rechtstreeks impact te hebben op de volledige organisatie.

Wat jij bouwt, wordt gebruikt door winkels, logistiek, finance, HR, marketing en management.

Je helpt Bike Republic groeien zonder dat de administratieve complexiteit mee groeit.

Description:
Don’t settle for just any consulting company, choose the one that’s right for you!




At Data Wizards, we value perseverance, curiosity, creativity, integrity and excellence. In that sense, we are looking for passionate AI & data professionals who want to help companies navigate the transition the world is facing today, and who want to be part of the Wizard adventure we are building.




On our side, we do our best to find exciting, challenging and meaningful projects for you. Today, we work with companies of all sizes, across various sectors, where we believe our work brings real value and purpose.




We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. So this job description is for anyone in data out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄




We’re on the lookout for an AI Engineer to join our team of Wizards!




As an AI Engineer, your mission would include:




Collaborating with clients to define business and technical requirements for AI and data-driven solutions.
Designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and AI solutions tailored to various industries.
Working with stakeholders to identify and implement AI strategies that drive business value.
Ensuring models are production-ready, scalable, and adhere to best DevOps/MLOps practices.
Leveraging cloud environments, particularly Azure, to optimize data processing and AI model performance.
Engaging with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, AI engineers, and consultants, to deliver high-quality AI solutions.
Supporting the continuous improvement of AI methodologies and contributing to internal innovations within the company.
Mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge across the organization.
Attending client meetings and presenting findings, recommendations, and AI solutions in a clear and structured manner.




Job requirements




You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:




Background




A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field (such as business or engineering).
3-4 years of experience in a consulting environment or a related AI/ML engineering role.
Experience working at the intersection of consulting, machine learning engineering, and data science.




Technical Skills




Strong expertise in Python and SQL.
In-depth knowledge of machine learning, AI, and statistical techniques.
Hands-on experience with NLP is a significant plus.
Proficiency in cloud environments, particularly Azure.
Familiarity with popular machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience deploying AI/ML models into production and working with LLMs in a real-world setting.
Knowledge of best practices in DevOps/MLOps.




Soft Skills




Strong client-facing skills with the ability to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.
A problem-solving mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous learning.




Practical Info




Languages: Fluent in English. French or Dutch Native.




We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.




Here’s a sneak peek at what we offer:

Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with a fuel card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers
Opportunity to earn company stock over time




🎯 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive

Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces with a 24/7 open gym fully equiped
A Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles 🎮
A massage chair for those deep-thinking moments 🧘
Fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕




✨ And most importantly, a growing company where opportunities are limitless!

HR Interview
Technical Interview

Potential Interview with client

The world is building one of the largest infrastructure shifts in history — and it needs better tools to get it done. The team you'll join




You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives.




How we operate





We care deeply about our customers and the problems we solve for them.


We move fast, keep things simple, and focus on what matters.


We keep our quality bar high by staying lean and hiring only the best.



Tasks


At Sitemark, AI sits at the heart of the product. Drones and robots capture vast amounts of imagery from renewable energy sites, and our computer-vision models turn it into the answers customers act on. We need someone to scale that capability so it ships reliably and moves real business metrics.




As our AI/ML Engineer, you own the AI/ML side of the platform: training and improving the computer-vision models behind our products, and making sure they actually ship and perform in production. You'll raise our throughput across model implementation, training runs, and dataset iteration — directly unblocking the team and our customers.




We're looking for a pragmatic engineer-scientist, not a paper-chaser. Models exist to solve real problems: if an off-the-shelf model fine-tuned on our data does the job, that's a great answer. We care about results in the product, not novelty in a paper. No solar or energy background required — we'll teach you the domain; curiosity matters more.




You'll report to the Head of Product & Engineering, with coaching and technical sparring from the Engineering Lead, and work in cross-functional squads alongside platform engineers, the product team, and — closely — our operations teams and customers.




What you'll do





Train, fine-tune, and ship computer-vision models for tasks like thermal anomaly detection and classification, defect detection on high-resolution imagery, object detection on drone imagery, and stitching/co-registration support.


Level up the MLOps backbone that lets us ship reliably: experiment tracking, reproducible training, dataset versioning, a model registry, deployment pipelines, production monitoring, and a feedback loop from labeled operations data back into training. This is where AI meets engineering, and it's a big part of what makes the role impactful.


Run the full experimental loop end to end: curate and improve datasets, design training runs, analyse errors, and iterate.


Take on the harder architectural problems when they matter — for example, models that reason over large spatial context (an entire site, not just a tile) where a standard fixed-resolution detector falls short.


Integrate models into the product end to end. A model isn't done when the metric looks good — it's done when it's running on real data in the platform and making the team or the customer faster.


Choose problems and approaches based on business impact — what actually moves the needle for our products and operations.





What success looks like after 6–12 months:





Your models are running in production on real data, moving the metrics our customers and operations teams care about.


The MLOps backbone is solid — training is reproducible, experiments are tracked, and shipping a new model is routine, not a fire drill.


A feedback loop runs from labeled operations data back into training, so the models keep getting better on their own cadence.


Throughput across model work, training runs, and dataset iteration is meaningfully higher than when you started.


AI is unblocking the roadmap, not bottlenecking it — the gaps we hired you to close are closed.



Requirements



Strong applied computer vision / deep learning experience — you've trained, fine-tuned, and debugged CV models, not just called APIs, and you understand what's happening inside them.


Hands-on with the experimental loop: dataset curation, augmentation, training, error analysis, iteration. When results are bad, you know how to diagnose why.


A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset — you reason about how a model will actually be used, what "good enough" means for the business, and the shortest path to a real result.


Strong fundamentals and clean engineering instincts. You write code meant to live in production — readable, testable, maintainable — not just notebook scratch.


Motivated to grow into the integration and MLOps side, and comfortable touching code beyond the model itself. (You don't need to be a senior full-stack engineer on day one.)


High intelligence and learning velocity — we care more about how you think and how fast you grow than years on a CV.


Comfortable working in English in a small, fast-moving team.





Big plus:





Aerial / drone / remote-sensing imagery (orthomosaics, geo-referencing, multi-band, large images).


Non-visual imagery (thermal, multispectral).


Detection, segmentation, keypoint, or multi-scale architectures applied to large or high-resolution images.


Production MLOps: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registries, monitoring.


Full-stack experience (Python, TypeScript, React, Postgres) — you'll get plenty of chances to use it.


Weakly- or self-supervised learning, active-learning loops.



Benefits



Real impact, fast: a clearly identified gap, a concrete roadmap, and customers waiting on the results. Your models will ship.


Breadth: from datasets and model work through MLOps and into product integration — you'll grow across the stack as much as you want.


A strategic seat: AI is central to where Sitemark is going, and you'll help shape that direction, not just execute on it.


A pragmatic culture: we care about results, not theatre — the boring solution when it works, the hard one when it doesn't.


Work on a mission that matters: accelerating the world's transition to renewable energy.


Competitive compensation including meaningful equity (stock options) with real upside.


Remote-friendly within Central European time zones — we have team members across Belgium and Poland, and we're open to additional locations with enough overlap with CET hours.

Title: Senior Applied Scientist
Description:
At TomTom, the Maps team sits at the heart of our vision to build the world's most accurate, fresh, and intelligent map. As an Applied Scientist, you will help evolve the Orbis Road Model Map and the Orbis Lane Model Map by transforming high ‑ fidelity, high ‑ volume data into map content that powers next ‑ generation navigation, automated driving, and high ‑ quality Guidance for millions of drivers.

You will t play a pivotal role in building navigation-related map content from a collection of massive geospatial data sources using ML algorithms and solutions. — fueling products and partnerships that rely on TomTom's map as a competitive differentiator, from global OEMs to cutting ‑ edge automated driving programs.

What You'll Do


Design and develop algorithms that extract actionable insights from massive, imperfect datasets, turning raw geospatial data into intelligence that powers the future of map-making technology. 
Work with one of the largest traffic data streams worldwide, applying your expertise to decode complex datasets and improve mobility systems. 
Take ownership of the full lifecycle of software projects, ensuring smooth transitions from research to production-level implementation. 
Support and improve production environments to guarantee operational excellence of the systems you build. 
Work closely with Software Engineers and Product Managers on the team.


What You'll Need


A university-level degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a relevant field. 
5+ years of industry experience developing production-grade code, with proficiency in Java and Python. 
Proven track record in solving business problems through ML solutions (e.g. Computer Vision, classic ML algorithms, etc.)
Strong skills in Software Engineering, both in greenfield projects and optimizing existing systems. 
You’re a collaborative team player who thrives in an international environment, and you have strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 


What's Nice To Have


Experience in handling large volumes of Geospatial data
Familiarity with DevOps practices and cloud platforms like Azure. 
Familiarity with Big Data pipelines (e.g. Spark/Kafka)


What We Offer

A competitive compensation package, of course.

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location.

Meet your team

We’re Maps, a global team within TomTom’s Location Technology Products technical unit. Our team is driven to deliver the most up-to-date, accurate and detailed maps for hundreds of millions of users around the world. Joining our team, you’ll continuously innovate our mapmaking processes, directly contributing to our vision engineering the world's most trusted and useful map.

At TomTom...

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

After you apply

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs .

TomTom is an equal opportunity employer

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Research Software Engineer
Description:
To strengthen VITO’s Environmental Intelligence unit, we are looking for several Research Software Engineers. You will help shape the next generation of GeoAI services, applying advances in artificial intelligence, foundation models and large-scale Earth observation processing. Our platforms support the European Commission, the European Space Agency and regional public authorities in their decisions on climate, food security, biodiversity and infrastructure.




We are looking for highly skilled software engineers and applied scientists with a broad foundation in data engineering and data science. The exact balance between platform engineering, large-scale data processing and applied machine learning will be shaped by your expertise and by project needs. Our end products must not only be innovative but also ready for trusted delivery—operable in regulated or access-restricted settings with strong requirements on robustness, traceability and information assurance. We therefore welcome applications from different profiles, including candidates who are stronger in some areas than others.




You join a talented team that operates at the forefront of European Space programmes, public policy and applied research. You work on systems with global visibility and concrete impact, with the freedom to bring your own ideas into platforms that are used well beyond our institute. We offer a working environment that combines the rigour of a research organisation with the pace of a modern software team.




Your responsibilities:




Design, build and operate software components for geospatial AI, ranging from data ingestion and processing pipelines to interactive analytical applications and machine learning workflows.
Develop and extend cloud-based platforms such as the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem and Terrascope, contributing to open standards such as openEO and reusable building blocks.
Apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence techniques to Earth observation, including deep learning, geospatial foundation models and agentic systems that combine reasoning with geospatial data and tools.
Translate requirements from thematic experts, end users and government stakeholders into robust, scalable and maintainable software.
Apply engineering practices such as continuous integration, automated testing, infrastructure as code and machine learning operations to keep services reliable and efficient.
Follow developments in software engineering, artificial intelligence and remote sensing closely, and bring relevant innovations into our platforms.




Job Requirements:




Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, engineering, physics, mathematics or an equivalent discipline.
Solid software engineering background, with strong skills in Python and/or Scala and good familiarity with modern development practices, version control, testing and code review.
Experience with distributed processing frameworks in cloud or HPC environments is a plus.
Working knowledge of machine learning and deep learning frameworks, and interest in applying them to geospatial or sensor data.
Ability to operate in an international, multidisciplinary environment, with excellent command of English.
A self-organized attitude, strong analytical skills and the communication skills needed to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
a NATO security clearance is expected for this job and will be part of the onboarding process.




Considered as a large plus:




Knowledge of the Dutch language
Experience with Earth observation data, in particular the Copernicus Sentinel missions, Synthetic Aperture Radar, hyperspectral or very high-resolution imagery.
Prior experience in classified information handling or accredited environments.
Contributions to open-source geospatial projects, open standards such as those of the Open Geospatial Consortium
Experience with geospatial foundation models, large language models applied to geospatial workflows, or model serving at scale.
Experience with secure software development, supply chain security and zero-trust architecture.







Offer




We operate in an activity‑based way, meaning your work activities guide where you work. Our headquarters is located in Mol, and we anticipate an average onsite presence of about 50%. We also support flexibility: part‑time remote work or working from one of our satellite offices in Antwerp‑Berchem, Genk, Leuven, Kortrijk or Ostend is possible.
A competitive salary with a range of benefits, including allowances, insurance, and a modular package of holidays.
Innovation is our asset, so it goes without saying that we give our employees the opportunity to take additional training courses and stay up-to-date in their field. You will always have the opportunity to broaden your knowledge and discover new technologies.
You will have the opportunity to be part of an organization with an international reputation, known for its cutting-edge technological research and scientific consultancy.
With us, you will contribute directly to sustainable developments at local, national and global level through your innovative applications. You provide answers to contemporary societal challenges.
Moreover, we highly value a good work-life balance at VITO! This is achieved by adopting a flexible attitude depending on your specific needs.

Title: Data analyst connectivity
Description:
Passionate people create exceptional things

Did you know that the solutions we develop are key part of most industries? We’re everywhere! Working with us means that you can make an impact towards a sustainable future. Here, your ideas are embraced, you never stop learning, and you can be part of the solution for a better tomorrow.

Join us and make the difference.

Your role

“Data mining” is a trend you can’t miss these days. The use of data is becoming more and more standard in different domains like product design or decision making.

Your role is to support other teams with your data analyses skills. Your focus point will be on “connectivity” data, but the requests can be very diverse. Many of our products are connected to the cloud, most of our products have digital twins, all our designs are created in a digital environment. There are plenty of opportunities to find relations, correlations, and influences to improve our products, processes or reporting tools. The knowledge and learnings are shared with the product development teams or other stakeholders like the service division or managment

Some Examples


Could we improve the quality of our machines by standardizing on specific items that appear to be more reliable than others?
What is a typical operating regime for a certain type of machines?
Are our machines performing as expected?
Do we get a lot of safety warning due to a clogged filter from a specific supplier?
At which average outlet pressure do our machines operate at 1000m above sea level?


To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.


Master's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related technical or scientific field.
Programming in Python (PySpark) and SQL is a must, basic knowledge of other programming languages is required
Experience in cloud computing, data analysis and signal processing is required
Notion of version control system, database structures and modeling techniques
Knowledge of Matlab, Power query and PowerBI is a plus
Interest in AI and the latest trends and evolutions in data science is a plus


In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Diverse by nature and inclusive by choice

Bright ideas come from all of us. The more unique perspectives we embrace, the more innovative we are. Together we build a culture where difference is valued and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.
